::: {.obsidian-privacy-policy}
:::

State the purpose in one paragraph. Name the controller and the
services this policy covers.

# Personal data we collect

Describe the categories of personal data the service collects and
the sources.

# How we use personal data

State each purpose and the lawful basis for it. Use one paragraph
per purpose.

# Sharing and disclosure

State who receives the personal data and why.

# Retention

State how long the organisation keeps the personal data and the
criteria for the period.

# Your rights

State the rights of the data subject under the applicable law:
access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and
objection.

# Contact

State how to contact the controller and the supervisory
authority.
